site: iCIMS / Mutual of Enumclaw; shared authentication and handoff paths
class: CAPTCHA handoff watches a different document from the account action
symptom: Mutual of Enumclaw paused on embedded profile creation. Local regression advances the application iframe while the outer tab stays fixed; the old wait times out.
root_cause: Account helpers scope into iCIMS, but apply_flow unwraps the page for handoff. The wait checks only the outer URL, password controls and CAPTCHA. Account helper CAPTCHA stops also use owner_needed, losing the explicit CAPTCHA wait mode.
why_tests_missed: f196 and f200 use top-level forms; they do not exercise the outer-tab handoff with an embedded or replaced application frame.
fix: Use the adapter-selected application frame for CAPTCHA observation, track frame replacement, preserve explicit account CAPTCHA stop reasons, and do not treat temporary frame detachment as progress.
prevention: Exercise the actual wrapper/frame topology through handoff, not only standalone controls.
